component.name: Desktop Subsystem for Android
component.summary: The dsa command and the device lender of DSA

description.p: Desktop Subsystem for Android™ (DSA) runs Android in a dedicated lightweight VM and shows each Android task as a desktop window. This is the user's half: the dsa command, and the program that lends the desktop's location, printers, web links and settings to the apps in Android. The service comes from the DSA package of the distribution.
